# Asset provenance and manifest

**Everything is original and generated by code in this repository.** There are no image files, no recorded audio, no third-party fonts and no downloaded content; nothing needs attribution.

| class | what | where | how produced |
|---|---|---|---|
| Graphics | every sprite, tile, UI panel, icon, background, particle | drawn at run time into 480x270 surfaces | `core/art.py` and each mode's `art.py` (pygame draw calls, ordered dither, lru-cached); Verdant's tiles, objects, buildings, villagers and creatures are in `modes/verdant/art.py` |
| Font | 5x8 pixel font | `core/font.py` | glyph bitmaps written in code (no TTF) |
| Music | 10 tracks x 3 layers | `assets/audio/music/` (rendered locally, git-ignored) | `tools/gen_audio.py` -> `core/scores.py`, `core/music.py`, `core/instruments.py`, `core/synth.py` |
| Effects | 167 sounds | `assets/audio/sfx/` (rendered locally, git-ignored) | `tools/gen_audio.py` -> per-mode `sfx.py` recipes and `core/sfxlib.py` |
| Content | levels, items, quests, creatures, recipes, echoes, lore | `data/<kind>/*.json` (757 entries) | authored JSON, schema-validated at load; Verdant's landmark templates were composed with `tools/gen_verdant_templates.py` |
| Worlds | maps, tracks, floors, galaxies, dungeons | none stored | seeded procedural generation at run time |

Audio files are listed with hashes, sizes, durations and loudness in `assets/audio/MANIFEST.json` (verified by tests) and in the generated table `docs/AUDIO_REPORT.md`. Screenshots in `docs/screens/` are produced by `tools/contact_sheet.py` from real gameplay.

## Dependencies (runtime)
pygame-ce 2.5.8 (LGPL-2.1-or-later) and NumPy (BSD-3-Clause family); pytest (MIT) for development. See `RESEARCH.md` for what was considered and rejected.

## Licences
The game's own code, data and generated assets are the project's. No third-party artwork or audio is bundled.
